$comment: Coverage thresholds enforced by orchestrator agents before task completion. Scope: backend/src/modules + lib + middleware (excludes bootstrap, config, db schema, frontend). Run: vitest run --coverage --coverage.include='backend/src/modules/**/*.ts' --coverage.include='backend/src/lib/**/*.ts' --coverage.include='backend/src/middleware/**/*.ts' --coverage.exclude='**/__tests__/**'

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST run this command and verify all thresholds pass before marking any task complete or creating a PR. Thresholds reflect Phase 1 baseline (service + repository layers at 100%, controller/routes/middleware/schemas untested). Raise thresholds per-module as HTTP-level tests are added.

auth-phase1.note: service.ts + repository.ts = 100%. controller, routes, schemas, middleware = 0% — no HTTP-level tests in Phase 1.
